main_text.p: est, quadragesimum nonum à desito postremo Jubilaico anno completo.

Poteram aliunde quoq; atqve 'abunde adstruere,annos Jubilæos in Epocha nostra ineuntes Septembri anno 5. 54. 103. 152. 201. 250. 299. 348. 397. 446. 495. 544. 593. 642. 691. 740. 789. 838. 887. 936. 985. 1034. 1083. 1132. 1181. 1230. 2279. 1328. 1377. 1426. 1475. 1524. 1573, qviqve postremus fuit nostro ævo 1622, eritqve posterorum 1671. Sed ut aliud hic tu me qvoq; juves, si qvid apud Eliezerum aut alios antiqvos (nam recentiores Rabinos nihil moror) ejusmodi indiciorum comperisti, hoc vero sine te exorem; in qva prece finio, & me tibi profiteor
Bruxella, Idius Decemb. Anno Christi nati 1637. qui est Epochae vulgatae 1633.
Addictum in Christo per omnia obsequiorum & communicatorum votorum momenta Godefr. Vendel. hactenus Pastorem Bethasiorum, nunc Hercanum sed Canonicum Gandavensem designatum.

page.notes: The page is set in roman with italics; the italic lines of the dedication are marked in the text. "2279" is printed so; the sequence of the Jubilee years would suggest 1279, but it is copied as the printer set it. The "s" long s is rendered as s throughout. The text "qvoq;" and "qviqve" are copied as printed. The running head is set in small capitals. The "Digitized by Google" line is omitted.
